release_name: Three more coordinates and a wrong town corrected
notes: Re-ran the remaining locality-level sites using the PARENT PARISH CHURCH coordinate as both the map-search bias and the acceptance reference, replacing the unreliable village geocoding. Three more sites located: Sainte-Jeanne-d Arc (Alma), whose Google Plus Code address reads QH7C+3PW, Alma; Sainte-Anne (Bonne-Mere), reverse-geocoding to Camp Bonne Mere, Queen Victoria, Flacq; and Saint-Coeur-de-Marie, which reverse-geocodes to Royal Road, Petite Riviere. That last one also exposed a data error: five rows carried the town Bambous, but the diocesan page is titled Saint-Coeur-de-Marie, Petite-Riviere and lists only this church and Notre-Dame-de-la-Mer, with no Bambous site at all. The town is corrected to Petite-Riviere. Sainte-Anne (Bonne-Mere) was found by accident while searching for a different chapel, which is a fair summary of how thin Google coverage is for the remainder. 27 sites remain at locality level and most now look genuinely unmapped: searches for them return a football club (Saint Georges FC for Saint-Georges, Camp-Diable), a neighbouring parish church, or nothing. Those need a local answer rather than more searching. No schedule data changed: 426 rows.
